financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Jefferies ATM sales of common stock, July 1 to August 6, 2025
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From July 1, 2025 through August 6, 2025, we sold an aggregate of 5,115,452 shares of common stock at a weighted-average price of $ 6.00 per share through the Jefferies ATM Offering Program for net proceeds of $ 29.8 million.
